title: Never Have I Ever: After Dark

items.text: Never have I ever kissed someone I had just met.
Never have I ever sent a flirty text to the wrong person.
Never have I ever been on a blind date.
Never have I ever gone skinny dipping.
Never have I ever had a crush on a friend's partner.
Never have I ever been asked to leave a bar.
Never have I ever danced on a table.
Never have I ever made up an excuse to escape a date.
Never have I ever snooped through a partner's phone.
Never have I ever woken up not knowing where I was.
Never have I ever used a dating app.
Never have I ever kissed someone in this room.
Never have I ever had a holiday romance.
Never have I ever texted an ex after one drink too many.
Never have I ever ended a relationship by text.
Never have I ever been caught sneaking home at night.
Never have I ever dated two people at the same time.
Never have I ever taken a glass home from a bar.
Never have I ever flirted my way out of a fine.
Never have I ever replied to a story just to start flirting.
Never have I ever fallen for someone at a wedding.
Never have I ever lied about where I was last night.
Never have I ever kissed on a first date.
Never have I ever dated someone much older than me.
Never have I ever pretended to be single.
Never have I ever got a tattoo I regret.
Never have I ever done a dare I'd rather forget.
Never have I ever kissed someone at midnight on New Year's Eve.
Never have I ever ordered food at four in the morning.
Never have I ever gone to work still feeling last night.
Never have I ever cried over someone who didn't deserve it.
Never have I ever written a love letter.
Never have I ever sent a screenshot of a chat to the person in that chat.
Never have I ever given an ex a second chance.
Never have I ever had a secret relationship.
Never have I ever said "I love you" before the other person did.
Never have I ever partied until sunrise and gone straight to breakfast.
Never have I ever given a fake number to someone hitting on me.
Never have I ever got someone's number in the queue for the bathroom.
Never have I ever hidden someone I was dating from my parents.
Never have I ever checked when someone was last online every five minutes.
